GENERATED MEMO:
# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**AB-Abbott Private Equity Fund Group - Revolving Credit Facility Sublimit Adjustment**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** June 17, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Multiple AB-Abbott affiliated investment funds, including AB-Abbott Private Equity Investors 2019 (Delaware) Fund L.P. (Initial Borrower) and seven other related fund entities, all operating as Delaware limited partnerships or Maryland corporation structures under the AB-Abbott/AB Private Credit Investors umbrella.

**Transaction Description:** Fund Group Facility Sublimit Adjustment Letter relating to an existing revolving credit agreement originally dated June 14, 2019. The transaction involves HSBC Bank USA, National Association as Administrative Agent and Lender, with additional lenders party to the facility. This represents the latest modification to a credit facility that has been amended twelve times since inception.

**Purpose of Financing:** Reallocation of existing fund group facility sublimits among the various borrower entities within the umbrella structure. No new debt issuance; rather an internal rebalancing of credit capacity allocation.

**Company Background:** The borrowing entities represent a collection of private equity and private credit investment funds managed under the AB-Abbott/AB Private Credit platform, with fund vintages ranging from 2019 to 2024, indicating an active fund management business with regular new fund formations.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Established credit relationship with multiple amendments demonstrating ongoing lender support since 2019
• Diversified borrower base across multiple fund entities and investment strategies (private equity and private credit)
• Regular fund formation activity suggesting active business operations and fundraising capabilities
• HSBC as administrative agent provides institutional-grade banking relationship
• Borrowers certified no events of default or potential defaults exist as of the effective date

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Limited visibility into underlying fund performance and investment portfolio quality
• Multiple borrower structure increases operational complexity and potential cross-contamination risk
• Frequent amendments (12 modifications since 2019) may indicate evolving credit needs or covenant management
• Fund industry exposure to market cycles and limited partner redemption pressures
• Concentration risk within single fund management platform

---

## 3. KEY DEAL TERMS

| **Term** | **Details** |
|----------|-------------|
| **Deal Size** | $135,000,000 (aggregate facility sublimits post-adjustment) |
| **Deal Price** | N/A |
| **Interest Rate** | N/A |
| **Maturity Date** | N/A |
| **Payment Frequency** | N/A |
| **Key Covenants** | Principal Obligations cannot exceed Available Commitments; Aggregate sublimits cannot exceed Maximum Commitment |
| **Administrative Agent** | HSBC Bank USA, National Association |
| **Facility Type** | Revolving Credit Agreement with Fund Group Sublimits |
| **Largest Sublimit** | AB Private Credit Investors Middle Market Direct Lending Fund L.P. - $90,000,000 (reduced from $110,000,000) |

---

*Note: This memorandum is based solely on the Fund Group Facility Sublimit Adjustment Letter dated June 17, 2024. Complete credit terms, pricing, and covenant details would require review of the underlying Credit Agreement and amendments.*
